outcome: Reference intervals for red blood cell parameters (hemoglobin, erythrocytes, hematocrit) at birth and in early childhood
cohort: 7,938 newborns from the Copenhagen Baby Heart Study and 295 newborns from the COMPARE study
finding: The study established new reference intervals for red blood cell parameters in early childhood and found that delivery mode impacts these parameters at birth, with lower values in children delivered by prelabor cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Hemoglobin, erythrocytes, and hematocrit were lower at birth in children delivered by prelabor cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
